item.title: Juistice Minister rules out immediate public inquiry into the Creeslough tragedy
item.description: Justice Minister Jim O’Callaghan has ruled out an immediate public inquiry into the Creeslough tragedy. Speaking to Highland Radio News in Letterkenny this morning, he said his view is justice isn’t delivered through inquiries, and if there is a prospect of one or more prosecutions, that should be the focus. item.title: November sees another drop in numbers on Live Register in Donegal

item.title: Donegal to receive over €300,000 in Local Enhancement Programme 2026
item.description: Donegal is set to receive over €303,465 as part of the Local Enhancement Programme 2026.
